Class BergmannAllenMorphologyEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier1.BergmannAllenMorphologyEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class BergmannAllenMorphologyEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Bergmann-Allen Ecomorphology & Thermoregulatory Scaling Engine.

Formalizes the universal allometric and morphological scaling laws established by Carl Bergmann (1847), Joel Asaph Allen (1877), Christopher Ruff (1994, 2002), and J. Bristol Foster's Island Rule (1964).

Key Biophysical Mechanics:

  1. Bergmann's Rule (Body Mass vs. Paleotemperature): \[ M^*(T) = M_{\text{ref}} \cdot \left[1.0 + \beta_{\text{bergmann}} \cdot \tanh\left(\frac{T_{\text{ref}} - T}{s_T}\right)\right] \] where body mass increases in cold periglacial environments to minimize thermal dissipation per unit volume.
  2. Allen's Rule (Surface-Area-to-Mass Ratio): \[ \frac{SA}{M} = c_{\text{geom}} \cdot M^{-1/3} \quad [\text{m}^2/\text{kg}] \] where distal limb length and cylindrical body diameter adapt to regulate conductive heat exchange.
  3. Foster's Insular Dwarfism / Gigantism Rule (1964): On isolated geographical islands with restricted resource area \(A_{\text{land}}\), large megafauna dwarf toward sustainable biomass ceilings (\(M \propto A_{\text{land}}^{1/3}\)).
  4. Dynamic Energy Budget (DEB) Somatic Maintenance Feedback: Thermoregulatory energy dissipation \([\dot{p}_M]\) scales with effective surface area: \[ [\dot{p}_M](T, M) = [\dot{p}_{M0}] \cdot \left[1.0 + \gamma_{\text{thermo}} \cdot \frac{SA}{M} \cdot \max(0, T_{\text{comfort}} - T)\right] \]

    calculateBergmannEquilibriumMass(double tempCelsius, double refMassTons)
    Calculates the equilibrium Bergmann body mass in metric tons for a given ambient temperature: \[ M^*(T) = M_{\text{ref}} \cdot \left[1.0 + \beta_{\text{bergmann}} \cdot \tanh\left(\frac{T_{\text{ref}} - T}{s_T}\right)\right] \]
    static double
    calculateFosterIslandDwarfismFactor(boolean isIsland)
    Calculates Foster's Island Dwarfism scaling factor for megafauna on restricted landmasses: \[ f_{\text{island}}(A_{\text{cell}}, N_{\text{neighbors}}) = \min\left(1.0, \; \left(\frac{A_{\text{effective}}}{A_{\text{mainland}}}\right)^{0.33}\right) \]
    static double
    calculateSurfaceAreaToMassRatio(double bodyMassKg)
    Calculates the Surface-Area-to-Body-Mass ratio (\(SA/M\)) according to Allen's rule: \[ \frac{SA}{M} = c_{\text{geom}} \cdot M_{\text{kg}}^{-1/3} \quad [\text{m}^2/\text{kg}] \]
    static double
    calculateThermoregulatoryMaintenanceMultiplier(double tempCelsius, double bodyMassKg)
    Calculates the thermoregulatory somatic maintenance multiplier for Dynamic Energy Budget: \[ \mu_{\text{thermo}} = 1.0 + \gamma_{\text{thermo}} \cdot \frac{SA}{M} \cdot \max(0, T_{\text{comfort}} - T) \]

    • calculateBergmannEquilibriumMass

      public static double calculateBergmannEquilibriumMass(double tempCelsius, double refMassTons)
      Calculates the equilibrium Bergmann body mass in metric tons for a given ambient temperature: \[ M^*(T) = M_{\text{ref}} \cdot \left[1.0 + \beta_{\text{bergmann}} \cdot \tanh\left(\frac{T_{\text{ref}} - T}{s_T}\right)\right] \]
      Parameters:
      tempCelsius - ambient mean surface temperature in \(^\circ\text{C}\)
      refMassTons - baseline taxon body mass in metric tons
      Returns:
      equilibrium adapted body mass in metric tons

    • calculateSurfaceAreaToMassRatio

      Returns:

    • calculateFosterIslandDwarfismFactor

      public static double calculateFosterIslandDwarfismFactor(boolean isIsland)
      Calculates Foster's Island Dwarfism scaling factor for megafauna on restricted landmasses: \[ f_{\text{island}}(A_{\text{cell}}, N_{\text{neighbors}}) = \min\left(1.0, \; \left(\frac{A_{\text{effective}}}{A_{\text{mainland}}}\right)^{0.33}\right) \]
